THE LOCAL MEANING

What it is.

A lower Fraser River boat trip for white sturgeon, with release as the trip objective. The lower-river scope matters. A tourism listing for this area does not establish access or rules for all sturgeon populations in British Columbia.

How it is fished.

Fish bottom bait from a guide boat and release the fish.

The research describes bottom bait from a guide boat. Ask how the crew anchors, fights, and releases a fish, and how each angler participates. Tourism sources advertise trips through the year, but they do not establish a single verified peak. Use provincial handling guidance for the actual release plan.

Planning format: Full day; river guide boat. Confirm the actual duration with the provider.

EDITORIAL PREPARATION ADVICE

What to bring.

  • A waterproof layer and warm clothing for an exposed river boat.
  • Stable footwear suited to the guide’s confirmed landing procedure.
  • A dry pouch for essentials; leave heavy personal tackle out until the guide approves it.

Before you go.

Does a year-round listing establish the best month?

No. It establishes an advertised trip format. Ask the guide to explain river conditions and the intended reach for your dates; no single peak is verified here.

What seasonal window does the evidence support?

Year-round trips are advertised. A single verified peak remains unknown. A seasonal account does not confirm current availability. Use the linked authority for current rules.

What must I confirm before I book this trip?

Confirm the complete sturgeon outfit and suitable safety equipment. Ask about handling, any tagging work, and whether photos require a shore landing. Confirm the tidal or non-tidal location and the applicable licenses. Castward has no confirmed guide inventory for this trip type.
